title: Sol object record (RFC-SOL-0001, published v0.1)
description: Normative object-record schema (the schema class missing from the v0.1 draft set; Appendix C requires it). Encodes decision Q3 (compression codecs: only the four registered identifiers of RFC section 43) and decision Q5 (object-size floor: 0 bytes to 1 GiB inclusive). In the exploded debug representation object records live at objects/records/<digest>.json; in the physical .solnb container they accompany each object entry.

compression.description: Registered compression identifiers (RFC section 43). Conformance floor: none + gzip (decision Q3).

size_bytes.description: Uncompressed size in bytes; 2^30 = 1 GiB (decision Q5).
